panel.meta_model_note: the composite arena book as it actually is: COMPOSITE_WEIGHTS names six signals but coverage is {'1': 206, '6': 1}, so 99.5% of names carry 12-1 momentum only

meta_model_own_score.n_effective_note: the sample size is the ERA count, not the name-day count (CANON section 58)

ret_12_1.verdict: RE-EXPRESSION: MMC +0.0000 is under a tenth of corr +0.0313; the ensemble already had 100% of this book's signal. Adding it changes no portfolio. This is the EXPECTED NULL when 99.5% of names carry one factor.
ret_12_1.definition: MMC = mean(resid * centred target) / (sd(gauss pred) * sd(target)), resid = gauss pred orthogonalised against gauss meta-model, per era, then averaged. Same denominator as corr, so the two are comparable and corr - MMC is what the ensemble already had.
ret_12_1.not_claimed: a correlation-space statement about one panel and one meta-model: not a portfolio result, not net of costs, and not evidence that a positive-MMC book makes money
ret_12_1.why: the meta-model itself -- the known answer: MMC must be 0
